propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture fails on 'git fetch origin tickets' with exit 128 but git's stderr is discarded because subprocess.run uses capture_output=True and check=True together
git fetch/archive/ls-tree calls in _dc_fixtures.py lack diagnostic context, raising CalledProcessError that reports only exit status, not git's actual error reason
fetch is a single un-retried network call on the critical path of a 41-minute live job, so transient failures take the cell out as ERROR
git archive and git ls-tree calls have identical capture_output+check=True shape and need the same diagnostic/retry treatment as fetch
fix requires a _run_git helper that captures output, performs its own check, and raises RuntimeError carrying command, exit status, and git's stderr verbatim
fetch_tickets helper must retry bounded transient failures (FETCH_ATTEMPTS=3) before failing, ensuring genuine misconfiguration still reds the lane rather than silently dropping coverage
